strings.d1.s0.name: Hosier Lane
strings.d1.s0.tips: Graffiti lane that changes daily, next to ACDC Lane.
strings.d1.s1.name: Degraves Street Breakfast
strings.d1.s1.tips: Laneway cafes: try a flat white and avocado toast, then walk on to Centre Place.
strings.d1.s2.name: State Library Victoria La Trobe Reading Room
strings.d1.s2.tips: Octagonal reading room, free to enter. Ned Kelly's armour is on display.
strings.d1.s3.name: Federation Square & ACMI
strings.d1.s3.tips: ACMI, the film museum, is free. Ian Potter NGV showcases Australian art, and the Yarra riverbank is right there.
strings.d1.s4.name: Lune Croissanterie Fitzroy
strings.d1.s4.tips: Called the "world's best croissant". Take tram 11 to Fitzroy and expect a queue.
strings.d1.b0.name: Higher Ground Breakfast
strings.d1.b0.tips: Brunch in a former power station on Little Bourke Street.
strings.d1.b1.name: Melbourne Museum Carlton
strings.d1.b1.tips: Natural history and an Aboriginal gallery, next to the Royal Exhibition Building. Alternative to ACMI.
strings.d2.s0.name: Queen Victoria Market
strings.d2.s0.tips: Market dating from 1878. Try the American Doughnut Kitchen van and the cheese and deli hall. The Wednesday night market runs in summer. Closed Monday and Wednesday.
strings.d2.s1.name: Royal Exhibition Building & Carlton Gardens
strings.d2.s1.tips: UNESCO-listed 1880 exhibition hall with fountains and gardens.
strings.d2.s2.name: Lygon Street
strings.d2.s2.tips: Little Italy: visit Brunetti pastry shop and Pellegrini's, where Melbourne coffee culture took off.
strings.d2.s3.name: Fitzroy Brunswick Street
strings.d2.s3.tips: Vintage shops, street art and the Rose Street Artists' Market at weekends.
strings.d2.s4.name: Naked for Satan Rooftop Bar
strings.d2.s4.tips: Fitzroy rooftop with city views at sunset and pintxos (Basque-style snacks).
strings.d2.b0.name: Pellegrini's Espresso Bar
strings.d2.b0.tips: Espresso bar unchanged since 1954, on Bourke Street.
strings.d2.b1.name: Melbourne Zoo
strings.d2.b1.tips: Zoo in Royal Park. Alternative to Fitzroy if you have children.
strings.d3.s0.name: Bells Beach
strings.d3.s0.tips: Tour departs 06:30 (130 AUD), or drive. Legendary surf beach at Torquay.
strings.d3.s1.name: Kennett River Koala Walk
strings.d3.s1.tips: Wild koalas and parrots in the trees along Grey River Road.
strings.d3.s2.name: Apollo Bay
strings.d3.s2.tips: Fishing town for fish and chips and calamari.
strings.d3.s3.name: Twelve Apostles
strings.d3.s3.tips: Limestone stacks (8 remain). Gibson Steps lead 86 steps down to the beach. The light is best in the afternoon.
strings.d3.s4.name: Loch Ard Gorge
strings.d3.s4.tips: Shipwreck cove and caves, 3 minutes from the Apostles. Allow 3 hours for the return journey.
strings.d3.b0.name: Cape Otway Lightstation
strings.d3.b0.tips: The oldest lighthouse on mainland Australia. Alternative to Apollo Bay.
strings.d3.b1.name: Apollo Bay Bakery
strings.d4.s0.name: Brighton Bathing Boxes
strings.d4.s0.tips: 82 colourful bathing boxes on Dendy Street Beach. Take the train to Middle Brighton; it is quiet in the morning.
strings.d4.s1.name: St Kilda Esplanade & Pier
strings.d4.s1.tips: Take tram 96 to the pier and the Luna Park laughing mouth. Little penguins appear at sunset under the pier.
strings.d4.s2.name: Acland Street Cake Shops
strings.d4.s2.tips: Monarch Cakes (1934) and European patisseries, a legacy of Jewish immigrants.
strings.d4.s3.name: Luna Park Melbourne
strings.d4.s3.tips: Amusement park from 1912. Entry is free, and the Scenic Railway wooden roller coaster costs 15 AUD.
strings.d4.s4.name: St Kilda Pier Penguins
strings.d4.s4.tips: Little penguins on the breakwater at sunset. No flash; volunteers are on hand.
strings.d4.b0.name: Stokehouse St Kilda
strings.d4.b0.tips: Stylish restaurant right on the beach.
strings.d4.b1.name: Jewish Museum of Australia
strings.d4.b1.tips: St Kilda's Jewish museum. Alternative to the garden.
strings.d5.s0.name: Brighton to Phillip Island and Churchill Island
strings.d5.s0.tips: Tour departs 12:00 (130 AUD, penguins included), or drive for 2 hours. Historic farm with sheep shearing.
strings.d5.s1.name: Koala Conservation Reserve
strings.d5.s2.name: Cape Woolamai Coastal Walk
strings.d5.s2.tips: Pink granite headland and surf beach, with the Pinnacles.
strings.d5.s3.name: The Nobbies & Seal Rocks
strings.d5.s3.tips: Rocky cliffs, gull colonies and fur seals. Bring binoculars.
strings.d5.s4.name: Penguin Parade
strings.d5.s4.tips: Thousands of little penguins waddle from the sea to their burrows at sunset. Book tickets online, no photography allowed, bring a coat.
strings.d5.b0.name: Penguin Parade Cafe
strings.d5.b0.tips: Visitor centre serving fish and soup.
strings.d5.b1.name: Panny's Chocolate Factory
strings.d5.b1.tips: Chocolate factory. Alternative to the koalas if you have children.
strings.d6.s0.name: Yarra Valley Dairy
strings.d6.s1.name: Domaine Chandon Yarra Valley
strings.d6.s1.tips: Sparkling wine tasting with vineyard views. Join a tour (about 150 AUD) or drive for 1 hour.
strings.d6.s2.name: Healesville Sanctuary
strings.d6.s2.tips: Native animals: kangaroos, platypuses, wombats and a bird show.
strings.d6.s3.name: Yering Station
strings.d6.s3.tips: Wine house on a historic farm, known for pinot noir and views.
strings.d6.b0.name: TarraWarra Estate
strings.d6.b0.tips: Wine and an art museum. Alternative to Yering.
strings.d6.b1.name: Innocent Bystander Healesville
strings.d6.b1.tips: Pizza and wine in the town centre.
strings.d7.s0.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
strings.d7.s0.tips: 38 hectares of gardens, with Ornamental Lake and views of the Shrine of Remembrance.
strings.d7.s1.name: Shrine of Remembrance
strings.d7.s1.tips: City views from the memorial balcony. Free.
strings.d7.s2.name: Southbank Promenade
strings.d7.s2.tips: Yarra riverbank walk. Eureka Skydeck (30 AUD) is optional.
strings.d7.s3.name: Southgate Breakfast and Lunch
strings.d7.s3.tips: Riverside views; have a farewell flat white.
strings.d7.s4.name: Southern Cross SkyBus
strings.d7.s4.tips: SkyBus to Tullamarine takes 30 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Eureka Skydeck
strings.d7.b0.tips: Level 88 and the Edge glass cube.
strings.d7.b1.name: Ponyfish Island
strings.note0: Get a myki card (from 7-Eleven). The centre is a Free Tram Zone, and the SkyBus airport transfer costs 22 AUD. For the Great Ocean Road, Phillip Island and Yarra Valley, take a tour or hire a car (they drive on the left).
strings.note1: NOTE: From June to September it is WINTER in Melbourne (8-14°C, rain), and you can get four seasons in one day, so dress in layers. Penguins arrive early in winter (17:45). Cafes and museums are warm. The Rising festival takes place in July.
strings.note2: The coffee culture is among the best in the world: try a flat white or a magic. Brunch costs 25-30 AUD, tours 130-150 AUD, and tipping is not expected.
strings.note3: Book the Penguin Parade online; photography is not allowed. Twelve Apostles looks best in afternoon light. Queen Vic is closed Monday and Wednesday.
strings.note4: Laneways: Hosier, ACDC, Centre Place, Degraves. For street art, head to Fitzroy and Collingwood, and Sydney Road in Brunswick.
strings.note5: UV is high in summer, so wear sunscreen. Tap water is safe to drink.
strings.transit.name: myki
strings.transit.why_chosen: Covers trams, trains and buses. Trams in the centre are FREE (Free Tram Zone), and the daily cap is about 11 AUD.
